plans.name: Split duplicate SKU lines
plans.idea: The shop deduplicates items by SKU when building the PayPal charge, using only the first line, but sums every line when storing or fulfilling the local order.
plans.expect: Pay $49.00 for one hoodie but receive three hoodies.

plans.name: Currency denomination switch
plans.idea: The create-order handler forwards a client-supplied currency while retaining the numeric value 49, and capture verification compares only the value while ignoring currency_code.
plans.expect: Approve and capture 49 JPY instead of 49 USD while the $49.00 local order is fulfilled.

plans.name: Capture pointed at larger order
plans.idea: The capture handler trusts a local order identifier supplied in the capture request body instead of the immutable mapping for the PayPal order in the path, and does not compare the captured amount with the target order total.
plans.expect: A $49.00 capture fulfills a separate three-hoodie order instead of only the approved one-hoodie order.

plans.name: Legit capture webhook remapped
plans.idea: The webhook handler retrieves the genuinely COMPLETED capture by its ID but trusts edited custom_id and invoice_id routing fields, without binding that capture to the target order's PayPal order or detecting that it already paid the legit order.
plans.expect: An approved-but-never-captured order is fulfilled from the legit $49.00 capture, yielding a second hoodie for the same payment.

plans.name: Latest-order capture mix-up
plans.idea: Capture resolution uses the shopper session or email's most recently created pending order rather than the local order originally associated with the PayPal order being captured.
plans.expect: Capturing the approved $49.00 PayPal order fulfills the newer three-hoodie order created afterward.

plans.name: Card order with borrowed proof
plans.idea: The card checkout or its shared order builder accepts client-supplied fulfillment and payment-proof fields after, or instead of, the card processor result, and does not check that the supplied PayPal capture is unused or belongs to this order.
plans.expect: Two hoodies are fulfilled despite the card being declined and no new payment being captured.
